---
title: "BBS and R Universe: summary"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(biocUniTools)
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
summary_file <- file.path("..", config$data_dir, "summary.rds")
has_data <- file.exists(summary_file)
if (has_data)
    s <- readRDS(summary_file)
```

Each row compares one Bioconductor branch and package type on `r config$platform`.
Workflows compare BBS `R CMD build` with R Universe source `R CMD check`; other
types compare `R CMD check`. NOTE counts as OK; WARNINGS matches WARNING. Select a
type for its packages.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run `biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("Updated %s.\n", format(attr(s, "created"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) summary_table(s)
```
